description: A real SendGrid Transactional Email API skill for managed-OAuth access to contacts, templates, sender identities, statistics, and transactional mail sending.
authorization_notes: The mail.send endpoint is irreversible and sends to real recipients; require explicit user confirmation of recipient list, content, and from address before sending.
Contact upsert operations modify the marketing contact database; confirm list membership changes with the user before executing.
Suppression management (unsubscribes, bounces) can permanently remove recipients from deliverability; handle with care.
Template activation changes which version of transactional emails are live; confirm with user before activating.
